decisions.question: Question pages: structured data type
decisions.why: Code-review: Google keeps QAPage for forums where users post answers; here the site gives the one official answer. Pavol: 'Dont just blindly copy the pattern though.' One-line change back if wanted.

decisions.question: Mock-exam guide /zkouska-nanecisto/ with JavaScript: start the timed exam on load (as proposed) or not?
options: open the Procvičovat tab, whose first button is Zkušební test
decisions.default_taken: open the Procvičovat tab and leave the URL
decisions.why: Starting a timer for someone who only came to read about the format made failed exams and false start_exam counts, and an expired exam could restart on a later reload.

decisions.question: Picture-only answers (23 questions) on question pages
decisions.why: Titles, descriptions and JSON-LD had no answer at all.

decisions.question: Sets of 20: in what order does the okruh queue run?
options: questions never answered first, then the rest (each shuffled)
decisions.why: So 'Dalších 20' moves through the okruh across visits instead of repeating what was seen.

decisions.question: Sets of 20: only single-okruh practice, or every practice selection?
options: every practice selection (several okruhy, all, search)
decisions.default_taken: every practice selection; a search selection is labelled 'Výběr podle hledání'
decisions.why: The same problem (no finishable set) exists for 'all okruhy' (1136). Review, bookmarks, the daily set and the exam are unchanged.

decisions.question: Set results: keep 'Opakovat chyby' next to 'Dalších 20' and 'Zpět'?
decisions.why: Pavol's words were 'next 20' or 'back'; the set's errors were already put right in the correction round. 'Moje chyby' stays on the Procvičovat tab. Review flagged it; kept.

decisions.question: Conversion per set or per okruh?
options: one conversion per finished set of 20
decisions.why: Activation counts distinct visitors with a conversion, so it is not inflated; raw conversion event counts now rise with sets played.

decisions.question: Outreach: autotrip.cz has no editorial address
options: email the advertising address asking to forward
decisions.default_taken: draft to the advertising address, asking to forward to the author
decisions.why: It is the only private channel published. Pavol decides whether to send.

decisions.question: Outreach: claim the law is quoted under every answer?
options: 'každá odpověď je vysvětlená a u většiny je doslovná citace'
decisions.why: 972 of 1136 explanations cite a provision; the rest honestly cite nothing. Same correction made in llms.txt and the guide FAQ.

proposals: Remember the set position across reloads (queue ids + offset in localStorage), so 'Dalších 20' survives closing the tab. Small; changes nothing about what a set is.
Results after a set of sign questions: show the sign picture next to each missed question (the list shows the text only, which is thin for 'Tato svislá dopravní značka označuje:').
Move the LAWS table into data/laws.json shared by src/domain/explanations.ts and scripts/question-pages.mjs (today a parity test guards the copy).
next: Pavol: send or drop the five drafts in docs/outreach/2026-10-30.md (nothing has been sent).
Pavol: Připravenost (readiness, A/B/C) and adopting Zbrojní's readiness card are still open.
Watch activation: first session_finish/conversion events from sets of 20 should appear within days; compare the share of new visitors with a conversion against the 0 of the last 14 days.
The daily flywheel IndexNow run picks up the 1137 new URLs (1136 questions + the guide); nothing was submitted from here.
